awakened_shrub.ja: 腰の高さほどの低木が根を足のように動かして歩く。枝先は爪のように曲がり、葉の奥に小さな光る目が覗く。
awakened_shrub.en: A waist-high shrub walking on root-like legs, twigs bent into claw shapes, two faint glowing eyes peering out from the leaves.

baboon.ja: 犬のような長い鼻面と鋭い牙を持つ茶色の毛並みのヒヒ。四つ足で身構え、歯をむき出して威嚇している。
baboon.en: A brown-furred baboon with a long dog-like muzzle and bared fangs, crouched on all fours in a threatening posture.

badger.ja: 顔に白黒の縞のある、ずんぐりした小型のアナグマ。短い脚と太い爪で地面を掘るように構える。
badger.en: A stocky little badger with a black-and-white striped face, short legs and thick digging claws, hissing defensively.

bat.ja: 革のような黒い翼を広げた小さなコウモリ。耳が大きく、牙を見せて暗闇から飛びかかる。
bat.en: A small bat with leathery black wings spread wide, oversized ears and tiny bared fangs, swooping out of the dark.

cat.ja: 背を丸めて毛を逆立てた黒猫。瞳が暗がりで黄色く光り、牙と爪を見せている。
cat.en: A black cat with arched back and bristling fur, yellow eyes glowing in the gloom, claws out and hissing.

commoner.ja: 粗末なチュニックと麻のズボンの一般人。農具か棍棒を握り、怯えながらも構えている。
commoner.en: An ordinary villager in a rough tunic and hemp trousers, clutching a club or farm tool, nervous but ready to fight.

crab.ja: 手のひらほどの赤茶色のカニ。両のハサミを高く掲げて横歩きで威嚇する。
crab.en: A palm-sized reddish-brown crab, both pincers raised high, scuttling sideways in a defensive stance.

deer.ja: 枝のような角を持つ茶色の牡鹿。細い脚で身構え、耳を立てて警戒している。
deer.en: A brown stag with branching antlers, slender legs tensed and ears raised in alarm, ready to bolt or charge.

eagle.ja: 金褐色の羽と白い頭の大鷲。翼を広げ、鋭いかぎ爪とくちばしを前に突き出す。
eagle.en: A golden-brown eagle with a pale head, wings spread, hooked beak and sharp talons thrust forward in attack.

giant_fire_beetle.ja: 犬ほどの大きさの黒い甲虫。頭の両脇の腺が赤く燃えるように光り、顎が大きい。
giant_fire_beetle.en: A dog-sized black beetle with two glowing red glands beside its head casting a fiery light, and large pincer-like mandibles.

goat.ja: 後ろに湾曲した角と粗い灰色の毛のヤギ。頭を下げて突進の構え。
goat.en: A shaggy grey goat with curved back-swept horns, head lowered to ram, hooves planted firmly.

hawk.ja: 斑の褐色の羽をもつ小型の鷹。翼を半開きにして鋭い目でにらむ。
hawk.en: A small hawk with mottled brown plumage, wings half-open, fierce yellow eyes and hooked beak.

homunculus.ja: 手のひらに乗るほどの小さな緑灰色の人型。コウモリの翼、小さな牙、細い手足で宙に浮く。
homunculus.en: A tiny greenish-grey humanoid with bat wings, spindly limbs and needle teeth, hovering in the air like a mischievous familiar.

hyena.ja: まだら模様の毛に前傾した背中のハイエナ。口を開け、下品な笑いのような表情で威嚇する。
hyena.en: A spotted hyena with sloping back and powerful jaws, mouth open in a mocking grin, hackles raised.

jackal.ja: 痩せた黄褐色の小型の犬のようなジャッカル。耳を立て、牙をむいて低く構える。
jackal.en: A lean, sandy-coloured jackal with large pointed ears, crouching low and baring its teeth.

lemure.ja: 溶けたロウのように崩れた人型の悪魔。目鼻のはっきりしない顔、ぶよぶよした桃色の肉体。
lemure.en: A pitiful fiend like a half-melted humanoid of pinkish wax, features blurred and sagging, shuffling forward mindlessly.

lizard.ja: 緑褐色の鱗の小さなトカゲ。長い尾と広げた指で壁に張り付く。
lizard.en: A small greenish-brown lizard with a long tail and splayed toes, clinging to a dungeon wall.

octopus.ja: 8本の触手を広げた赤茶色のタコ。大きな目で見つめ、吸盤が並ぶ。
octopus.en: A reddish-brown octopus with eight suckered tentacles spread wide and large watchful eyes.

owl.ja: 灰褐色の羽の小さなフクロウ。丸い大きな目で見開き、音もなく翼を広げる。
owl.en: A small grey-brown owl with huge round eyes, wings silently spread, talons extended.

quipper.ja: 鋭い歯の並ぶ口を開けた、手のひら大の銀赤色の肉食魚。
quipper.en: A hand-sized piranha-like fish, silver with red belly, mouth gaping with rows of needle teeth.

rat.ja: 黒ずんだ毛の小さなネズミ。長い尾と赤い目、前歯をむいている。
rat.en: A small dark-furred rat with red eyes, long bare tail and bared front teeth.

raven.ja: 艶のある漆黒の羽のワタリガラス。太いくちばしと賢そうな目。
raven.en: A large glossy black raven with a thick beak and knowing, beady eyes, wings half-spread.

scorpion.ja: 黒い外殻の小さなサソリ。両のハサミを構え、毒針の尾を高く反らす。
scorpion.en: A small black scorpion with raised pincers and a curled stinger tail poised to strike.

spider.ja: 毛深い黒い脚の小さなクモ。複数の目が光り、牙をむく。
spider.en: A small hairy black spider with glinting multiple eyes and visible fangs.

vulture.ja: 禿げた赤い頭と黒い羽のハゲワシ。猫背に翼を広げ、腐肉を狙う目つき。
vulture.en: A hunched vulture with bald red head and ragged black feathers, wings spread, eyeing carrion.

weasel.ja: 細長い茶色の体に白い腹のイタチ。素早く身をくねらせ、小さな牙を見せる。
weasel.en: A slender brown weasel with a white belly, body twisting mid-pounce, tiny sharp teeth bared.

bandit.ja: 革鎧に頭巾の山賊。使い込んだ曲刀を握り、顔は布で半ば隠している。
bandit.en: A scruffy bandit in patched leather armour and a hood, lower face masked by a scarf, gripping a worn scimitar.

blood_hawk.ja: 赤褐色の羽と血の色の目を持つ鷹。くちばしが長く鋭い。
blood_hawk.en: A hawk with rust-red feathers and blood-coloured eyes, long dagger-like beak, diving to attack.

camel.ja: こぶのある砂色のラクダ。長い首と大きな足、気だるげな顔。
camel.en: A sand-coloured humped camel with a long neck, wide padded feet and a bored expression.

cultist.ja: 暗い色のローブにフードの狂信者。胸に不吉な印、短剣を両手で掲げる。
cultist.en: A hooded cultist in dark robes bearing a sinister symbol, raising a curved dagger in both hands, face in shadow.

flying_snake.ja: 羽毛の翼を持つ細い蛇。鮮やかな緑と赤の鱗で宙を泳ぐ。
flying_snake.en: A slender snake with feathered wings, bright green and red scales, undulating through the air.

giant_crab.ja: 人の胴ほどある巨大なカニ。苔のついた甲羅と大きな両のハサミ。
giant_crab.en: A crab as big as a man's torso with a moss-encrusted shell and two massive pincers raised.

giant_rat.ja: 犬ほどの大きさの灰茶のネズミ。黄ばんだ前歯と裸の尾。
giant_rat.en: A dog-sized grey-brown rat with yellowed front teeth and a long hairless tail.

giant_rat_diseased.ja: 毛が抜け落ち、皮膚にただれのある病んだ巨大ネズミ。目は濁っている。
giant_rat_diseased.en: A giant rat with patchy fur, sores on its skin and cloudy eyes, drooling and sickly.

giant_weasel.ja: 馬ほどの長さの茶色いイタチ。しなやかな体で低く身構え、牙をむく。
giant_weasel.en: A weasel as long as a pony, sleek brown fur, low sinuous stance with fangs bared.

guard.ja: 鎖帷子と兜、槍と盾を持つ衛兵。真面目な顔で構える。
guard.en: A town guard in chain mail and a steel cap, holding a spear and a round shield, stern and alert.

kobold.ja: 小柄な赤褐色の鱗の竜人。小さな角、粗末な革と槍、ずる賢い目。
kobold.en: A small reddish-brown scaled reptilian humanoid with little horns, ragged leather and a crude spear, eyes cunning.

mastiff.ja: 太い首とたるんだ顔の大型の番犬。黒い毛並みで牙をむく。
mastiff.en: A large black mastiff with a thick neck and jowly face, teeth bared in a low growl.

merfolk.ja: 上半身は人、下半身は青緑の魚の尾の海の民。三叉の槍と貝の装飾。
merfolk.en: A sea-dweller with a human torso and blue-green fish tail, carrying a trident and wearing shell ornaments.

mule.ja: 長い耳の灰色のラバ。荷を背負い、頑固そうな表情。
mule.en: A grey long-eared mule with a stubborn expression, carrying a loaded pack saddle.

noble.ja: 刺繍のある上着にマント、細身の剣を持つ貴族。傲慢な表情。
noble.en: A haughty noble in an embroidered doublet and cloak, hand on a slender rapier, chin raised.

poisonous_snake.ja: 褐色と黒のまだら模様の小さな蛇。頭を上げ、牙を見せる。
poisonous_snake.en: A small brown-and-black patterned snake, head raised and fangs exposed in a strike pose.

pony.ja: ずんぐりした栗毛の小型の馬。たてがみがもじゃもじゃ。
pony.en: A stocky chestnut pony with a shaggy mane, sturdy and calm.

stirge.ja: コウモリの翼と蚊のような長い吸血の口吻を持つ小さな怪物。4本の脚。
stirge.en: A small winged pest with bat wings, four clawed legs and a long needle-like proboscis for drinking blood.

tribal_warrior.ja: 毛皮と骨の飾り、顔に彩色を施した部族の戦士。槍と皮の盾を持つ。
tribal_warrior.en: A tribal warrior in furs and bone ornaments, face painted, carrying a spear and a hide shield.

acolyte.ja: 白い祭服に聖印を下げた若い信者。メイスを握り、祈る表情。
acolyte.en: A young temple acolyte in white vestments with a holy symbol, gripping a mace, expression devout.

axe_beak.ja: 斧のような太い嘴のダチョウに似た大きな飛べない鳥。長い脚で突進する。
axe_beak.en: A tall flightless bird like an ostrich with a heavy axe-shaped beak and powerful running legs.

blink_dog.ja: 黄褐色で短毛の賢そうな犬。青白い光のきらめきに包まれて姿がぼやける。
blink_dog.en: A lean tawny dog with intelligent eyes, its outline shimmering with pale blue light as it blinks through space.

boar.ja: 黒い剛毛と湾曲した牙のイノシシ。頭を下げて突撃する。
boar.en: A bristly black boar with curved tusks, head lowered in a charge.

constrictor_snake.ja: 太い緑褐色の大蛇。とぐろを巻き、獲物を締め上げようとする。
constrictor_snake.en: A thick olive-brown constrictor snake coiled and rearing, ready to crush its prey.

draft_horse.ja: がっしりした体の荷引き馬。栗毛に長い脚毛、首輪の馬具。
draft_horse.en: A heavy chestnut draft horse with feathered hooves and a thick neck, wearing a harness collar.

dretch.ja: 小柄で腹の膨れた悪魔。灰色の皮膚、長い腕、豚のような顔に小さな角。
dretch.en: A squat pot-bellied demon with grey hide, dangling arms, piggish face and tiny horns, sullen and ugly.

drow.ja: 黒い肌と白い髪のエルフ。細身の鎖帷子にマント、曲刀と小さな弩。
drow.en: A dark-skinned elf with white hair in fine black chain mail and cloak, holding a scimitar and hand crossbow.

elk.ja: 巨大な枝角を持つ茶色の大鹿。胸が厚く、堂々と立つ。
elk.en: A large brown elk with a huge spread of antlers and a thick chest, standing proud.

flying_sword.ja: 柄に誰もいないまま宙に浮いて斬りかかる長剣。刃がほのかに光る。
flying_sword.en: A longsword floating in the air with no wielder, blade faintly glowing, poised to slash.

giant_badger.ja: 犬より大きなアナグマ。白黒の顔、太い爪で土を掻く。
giant_badger.en: A badger bigger than a dog with striped face and thick claws, snarling fiercely.

giant_bat.ja: 翼を広げると人より大きな黒いコウモリ。大きな牙と耳。
giant_bat.en: A huge black bat with a wingspan wider than a man, large fangs and ears.

giant_centipede.ja: 腕ほどの長さの赤黒いムカデ。無数の脚と毒の顎。
giant_centipede.en: A red-black centipede as long as an arm, countless legs and venomous mandibles.

giant_frog.ja: 犬ほどの大きさの緑のカエル。大きな口と長い舌。
giant_frog.en: A dog-sized green frog with a wide gaping mouth and bulging eyes.

giant_lizard.ja: 馬ほどの大きさの緑灰色のトカゲ。鋭い爪と長い舌。
giant_lizard.en: A horse-sized grey-green lizard with sharp claws and a flicking tongue.

giant_owl.ja: 翼を広げると部屋いっぱいの白と灰色のフクロウ。大きな瞳。
giant_owl.en: A huge silent owl of white and grey feathers, enormous eyes, wings filling the room.

giant_poisonous_snake.ja: 人の腕ほど太い斑模様の毒蛇。鎌首をもたげ牙を出す。
giant_poisonous_snake.en: A venomous snake as thick as a man's arm, patterned scales, rearing with fangs out.

giant_wolf_spider.ja: 犬ほどの大きさの毛深い褐色のクモ。8つの目が光る。
giant_wolf_spider.en: A dog-sized hairy brown spider with eight glinting eyes, crouched to leap.

goblin.ja: 小柄で緑色の肌、尖った耳の邪悪な小鬼。ぼろ革鎧と短剣。
goblin.en: A small green-skinned goblin with pointed ears and a wicked grin, in ragged leather with a crude short sword.

grimlock.ja: 目のない灰色の肌の人型。鼻と口が大きく、骨の棍棒を持つ。
grimlock.en: A grey-skinned eyeless humanoid with a wide nose and mouth, hunched, wielding a bone club.

panther.ja: 黒い毛並みの大型の猫。身を低くして跳びかかる構え。
panther.en: A sleek black panther crouched low, muscles coiled to pounce, eyes glowing green.

pseudodragon.ja: 猫ほどの大きさの赤茶色の小さなドラゴン。毒針の尾と賢い目。
pseudodragon.en: A cat-sized reddish-brown miniature dragon with a barbed tail and clever eyes.

riding_horse.ja: すらりとした栗毛の乗用馬。鞍をつけている。
riding_horse.en: A sleek chestnut riding horse wearing a saddle, alert and ready.

skeleton.ja: 古びた鎧の断片を身につけた人の骸骨。錆びた剣と盾。
skeleton.en: A human skeleton in scraps of ancient armour, holding a rusty sword and a battered shield, eye sockets glowing faintly.

sprite.ja: トンボの羽を持つ手のひらサイズの妖精。葉の服と小さな剣と弓。
sprite.en: A palm-sized fey with dragonfly wings, dressed in leaves, carrying a tiny sword and bow.

steam_mephit.ja: 白い蒸気でできた小さな翼のある小鬼。にやりと笑う。
steam_mephit.en: A small winged imp made of swirling white steam, grinning mischievously.

swarm_of_bats.ja: 無数の黒いコウモリが密集して飛ぶ群れ。闇のうねりのよう。
swarm_of_bats.en: A dense swirling cloud of dozens of small black bats, wings and fangs everywhere.

swarm_of_rats.ja: 床を埋め尽くす無数のネズミの群れ。赤い目と長い尾。
swarm_of_rats.en: A seething mass of dozens of rats flooding across the floor, red eyes and tails everywhere.

swarm_of_ravens.ja: 黒い羽が嵐のように渦巻くワタリガラスの群れ。
swarm_of_ravens.en: A whirling storm of black ravens, beaks and wings filling the air.

violet_fungus.ja: 人の背丈ほどの紫色のキノコ。胞子を撒く触手のような枝が伸びる。
violet_fungus.en: A man-sized purple mushroom with tentacle-like fronds reaching out, spores drifting around it.

wolf.ja: 灰色の毛並みの狼。牙をむき、身を低くして唸る。
wolf.en: A grey wolf with bared fangs, crouched low and snarling.

zombie.ja: 腐りかけた肉のぼろをまとった歩く死体。濁った目でよろめく。
zombie.en: A shambling corpse with rotting grey flesh and tattered clothes, cloudy eyes, arms reaching forward.

ape.ja: 黒い毛の大型の類人猿。拳を叩きつけ、牙をむく。
ape.en: A large black-furred ape beating its chest, teeth bared.

black_bear.ja: 黒い毛並みの中型の熊。後ろ足で立ち、爪を振り上げる。
black_bear.en: A black bear rearing on its hind legs, claws raised.

cockatrice.ja: コウモリの翼とトカゲの尾を持つ鶏のような怪物。黄色い目。
cockatrice.en: A rooster-like monster with bat wings and a scaly lizard tail, yellow eyes glaring.

crocodile.ja: 緑褐色の鱗に覆われた大きなワニ。水面から顎を開けて襲いかかる。
crocodile.en: A large crocodile with green-brown armoured scales, jaws open wide as it lunges from the water.

darkmantle.ja: 天井に張り付く黒い傘のような怪物。触手を垂らし、岩に擬態する。
darkmantle.en: A black umbrella-shaped creature clinging to the ceiling, tentacles dangling, mimicking stone.

deep_gnome_svirfneblin.ja: 灰色の肌と岩のような髪の小柄なノーム。革鎧につるはし。
deep_gnome_svirfneblin.en: A small gnome with grey stony skin and rocky hair, wearing leather armour and holding a pick.

dust_mephit.ja: 砂と塵でできた小さな翼のある小鬼。乾いた笑い。
dust_mephit.en: A small winged imp made of swirling dust and sand, cackling dryly.

giant_goat.ja: 馬ほどの大きさの長い角の山羊。粗い毛並み。
giant_goat.en: A horse-sized goat with long curved horns and shaggy coat, head lowered to charge.

giant_sea_horse.ja: 馬ほどの大きさの青緑のタツノオトシゴ。優雅に泳ぐ。
giant_sea_horse.en: A horse-sized blue-green sea horse, curling tail, gliding through water.

giant_wasp.ja: 犬ほどの大きさの黄色と黒のスズメバチ。毒針を構える。
giant_wasp.en: A dog-sized yellow-and-black wasp with a glistening stinger, wings buzzing.

gnoll.ja: ハイエナの頭を持つ毛むくじゃらの人型。斑の毛並み、粗末な槍と盾。
gnoll.en: A hyena-headed humanoid with spotted shaggy fur, crude spear and hide shield, grinning savagely.

gray_ooze.ja: 床を這う灰色の粘液。石のように見えるがぬめり光る。
gray_ooze.en: A puddle of grey slime oozing across the floor, glistening like wet stone.

hobgoblin.ja: 赤茶の肌に黒い髪の屈強なゴブリン兵。鎖帷子と長剣、軍の規律を感じさせる。
hobgoblin.en: A tall disciplined goblinoid soldier with red-brown skin and dark hair, in chain mail with a longsword and shield.

ice_mephit.ja: 氷の結晶でできた小さな翼のある小鬼。青白い冷気をまとう。
ice_mephit.en: A small winged imp made of jagged blue-white ice, breathing frost.

lizardfolk.ja: 緑の鱗に長い尾のトカゲ人間。骨の棍と皮の盾。
lizardfolk.en: A green-scaled reptilian humanoid with a long tail, carrying a bone club and hide shield.

magma_mephit.ja: 溶岩と黒い岩でできた小さな翼のある小鬼。赤く光る。
magma_mephit.en: A small winged imp of black rock veined with glowing red magma.

magmin.ja: 燃える岩の小さな人型。黒い殻の割れ目から炎が漏れる。
magmin.en: A small humanoid of blackened rock with flames leaking from cracks, body wreathed in fire.

orc.ja: 灰緑の肌に牙を持つ屈強なオーク。毛皮と粗い鎧、大斧。
orc.en: A burly orc with grey-green skin and jutting tusks, in furs and crude armour, swinging a great axe.

reef_shark.ja: 灰色の中型のサメ。白い腹と鋭い歯の列、冷たい黒い目で水中を滑るように迫る。
reef_shark.en: A grey reef shark with a white belly and rows of sharp teeth, cruising forward.

rust_monster.ja: 甲虫のような体に2本の羽毛状の触角を持つ怪物。赤錆色の鱗。
rust_monster.en: A beetle-like creature with rust-coloured armoured hide and two feathery antennae, tail ending in a paddle.

sahuagin.ja: 鮫のような顔の緑の鱗の魚人。背びれと水かき、三叉槍。
sahuagin.en: A shark-faced fish-man with green scales, fins and webbed claws, holding a trident.

satyr.ja: 山羊の脚と角を持つ陽気な半人。笛を持ち、いたずらっぽい笑み。
satyr.en: A goat-legged horned fey with a mischievous grin, holding pan pipes.

scout.ja: 緑と茶の革鎧にフードの斥候。弓と短剣、森に溶け込む装い。
scout.en: A scout in green and brown leathers with a hood, carrying a longbow and short sword.

shadow.ja: 人の形をした黒い影。実体がなく、床から立ち上がる。
shadow.en: A humanoid shape of pure darkness rising from the floor, featureless and wispy.

swarm_of_beetles.ja: 床を覆う黒い甲虫の群れ。光る甲羅がひしめく。
swarm_of_beetles.en: A dense carpet of hundreds of black beetles with glinting shells swarming forward.

swarm_of_centipedes.ja: 赤黒いムカデが無数に絡み合ってうごめく群れ。無数の脚と毒の顎が床を覆う。
swarm_of_centipedes.en: A writhing tangle of dozens of red-black centipedes crawling over each other.

swarm_of_insects.ja: 羽音を立てて渦巻く虫の雲。ハエと甲虫が混じる。
swarm_of_insects.en: A buzzing cloud of mixed flies, gnats and beetles swirling in the air.

swarm_of_spiders.ja: 無数の小さな黒いクモが波のように押し寄せる群れ。
swarm_of_spiders.en: A wave of countless small black spiders surging across the floor and walls.

swarm_of_wasps.ja: 黄色と黒のスズメバチが渦巻く怒れる群れ。
swarm_of_wasps.en: An angry swirling swarm of yellow-and-black wasps.

thug.ja: 傷だらけの大男のならず者。革のベストに棍棒、睨みつける。
thug.en: A scarred brute in a leather vest with a heavy club, glaring menacingly.

warhorse.ja: 黒い毛並みのたくましい軍馬。鎧の馬具をつけ、前脚を上げる。
warhorse.en: A powerful black warhorse in barding, rearing with hooves raised.

warhorse_skeleton.ja: 骨だけになった軍馬。錆びた馬具が垂れ下がる。
warhorse_skeleton.en: The bare skeleton of a warhorse, rusted barding hanging from its ribs, eye sockets glowing.

worg.ja: 狼より大きく邪悪な顔つきの黒灰色の獣。赤い目。
worg.en: A huge wolf-like beast with dark grey fur, evil red eyes and a cunning snarl.

animated_armor.ja: 中身のない全身板金鎧がひとりでに動く。兜の隙間は暗く、長剣を構える。
animated_armor.en: A full suit of plate armour moving with no one inside, visor dark and empty, raising a longsword.

brass_dragon_wyrmling.ja: 真鍮色の鱗の小さなドラゴン。頭に薄い翼状のひだ、好奇心のある目。
brass_dragon_wyrmling.en: A small dragon with brass-coloured scales, a flared frill behind its head and curious, friendly eyes.

brown_bear.ja: 茶色の毛の大きな熊。後ろ足で立ち、咆哮する。
brown_bear.en: A large brown bear rearing up and roaring, claws spread.

bugbear.ja: 毛むくじゃらで大柄なゴブリン族。熊のような鼻、棘付きのモーニングスター。
bugbear.en: A big hairy goblinoid with a bear-like snout and yellow eyes, wielding a spiked morningstar.

copper_dragon_wyrmling.ja: 銅色の鱗の小さなドラゴン。後ろに伸びる角と悪戯っぽい笑み。
copper_dragon_wyrmling.en: A small dragon with copper scales, swept-back horns and a playful, sly smile.

death_dog.ja: 2つの頭を持つ毛のない黒い犬。腐臭と牙、赤い目。
death_dog.en: A hairless black hound with two snarling heads, red eyes and mangy hide.

dire_wolf.ja: 馬ほどの大きさの黒い狼。巨大な牙と太い首。
dire_wolf.en: A horse-sized black wolf with massive fangs and a thick neck, snarling.

dryad.ja: 樹皮のような肌と葉の髪を持つ美しい森の精。木から現れる。
dryad.en: A beautiful forest spirit with bark-like skin and hair of leaves, stepping out of a tree trunk.

duergar.ja: 灰色の肌と白髪の陰気なドワーフ。鱗鎧と戦斧、険しい目。
duergar.en: A grim grey-skinned dwarf with white beard in scale armour, holding a war pick and shield.

ghoul.ja: 痩せた灰色の食屍鬼。長い爪と牙、血走った目で飢えている。
ghoul.en: A gaunt grey ghoul with long claws, sharp teeth and hungry bloodshot eyes, hunched over.

giant_eagle.ja: 翼を広げると人の3倍ある巨大な鷲。金色の羽。
giant_eagle.en: A massive golden eagle with a wingspan three times a man's height, talons ready.

giant_hyena.ja: 馬ほどの大きさのハイエナ。斑の毛と強い顎。
giant_hyena.en: A horse-sized spotted hyena with crushing jaws, cackling.

giant_octopus.ja: 触手が部屋を覆うほどの巨大なタコ。赤茶の皮膚と大きな目。
giant_octopus.en: A giant reddish octopus with tentacles sprawling across the room and huge eyes.

giant_spider.ja: 馬ほどの大きさの黒い毛深いクモ。8つの目と滴る毒牙。
giant_spider.en: A horse-sized hairy black spider with eight eyes and dripping fangs.

giant_toad.ja: 馬ほどの大きさのいぼだらけの茶色いヒキガエル。
giant_toad.en: A horse-sized warty brown toad with a huge mouth and bulging eyes.

giant_vulture.ja: 巨大なハゲワシ。禿げた赤い頭、ぼろぼろの黒い翼。
giant_vulture.en: A giant vulture with bald red head and ragged black wings, hunched and menacing.

harpy.ja: 女の顔と胴にハゲワシの翼と脚を持つ怪物。汚れた羽と鋭い爪。
harpy.en: A monster with a woman's face and torso, vulture wings and clawed legs, filthy feathers, singing.

hippogriff.ja: 鷲の頭と翼、前脚に馬の後ろ身を持つ獣。茶色の羽毛と毛並み。
hippogriff.en: A beast with the head, wings and foreclaws of an eagle and the hindquarters of a horse, brown feathers and coat.

imp.ja: 赤い肌の小さな悪魔。コウモリの翼、小さな角、毒針の尾。
imp.en: A tiny red-skinned devil with bat wings, little horns and a stinging tail, smirking.

lion.ja: たてがみの立派な雄ライオン。咆哮し、爪を出す。
lion.en: A male lion with a full mane, roaring with claws extended.

quasit.ja: 緑色の小さな悪魔。角と棘、ひょろ長い手足、邪悪な笑み。
quasit.en: A small green demon with horns, spines and spindly limbs, grinning wickedly.

specter.ja: 半透明の青白い亡霊。苦悶の顔で宙に浮く。
specter.en: A translucent pale-blue ghost with a tormented face, floating in the air.

spy.ja: 地味な服にフードの密偵。短剣を隠し持ち、影に溶ける。
spy.en: A hooded spy in plain dark clothes, dagger half-hidden, melting into the shadows.

swarm_of_quippers.ja: 水中で渦巻く無数の肉食魚の群れ。銀の鱗と歯。
swarm_of_quippers.en: A churning school of dozens of piranha-like fish, silver scales and snapping teeth.

tiger.ja: 橙と黒の縞の大きな虎。身を低くして忍び寄る。
tiger.en: A large orange-and-black striped tiger stalking low, eyes fixed on its prey.

ankheg.ja: 馬ほどの大きさの昆虫のような怪物。茶色の甲殻、大きな顎、土から現れる。
ankheg.en: A horse-sized insectoid burrower with brown chitin, huge mandibles and many legs, bursting from the ground.

awakened_tree.ja: 巨大な木が根を足にして歩く。幹に顔のような洞、枝が腕。
awakened_tree.en: A huge tree walking on its roots, a face-like hollow in the trunk, branches as arms.

azer.ja: 炎の髪と髭を持つ銅色の肌のドワーフ。鎧とハンマー。
azer.en: A dwarf-like being with bronze skin and hair and beard of living flame, in armour with a warhammer.

bandit_captain.ja: 革と鎖の鎧に羽飾りの帽子の山賊頭。曲刀と短剣の二刀流。
bandit_captain.en: A swaggering bandit leader in studded leather and a feathered hat, fighting with scimitar and dagger.

berserker.ja: 毛皮をまとい上半身裸の狂戦士。大斧を振り上げ、怒りの形相。
berserker.en: A bare-chested berserker in furs, face twisted with rage, raising a great axe.

black_dragon_wyrmling.ja: 黒い鱗の小さなドラゴン。前に曲がった角、酸の滴る口。
black_dragon_wyrmling.en: A small dragon with black scales, forward-curving horns and acid dripping from its jaws.

bronze_dragon_wyrmling.ja: 青銅色の鱗の小さなドラゴン。ひれのような耳と海辺の雰囲気。
bronze_dragon_wyrmling.en: A small dragon with bronze scales, fin-like ears and webbed claws, with a seafaring look.

centaur.ja: 上半身は人、下半身は馬の戦士。弓と槍、栗毛の馬体。
centaur.en: A warrior with a human torso on a chestnut horse body, carrying a longbow and spear.

cult_fanatic.ja: 暗いローブに血の印の狂信者指導者。目を見開き、短剣と聖印を掲げる。
cult_fanatic.en: A wild-eyed cult leader in dark robes marked with blood symbols, raising a dagger and unholy symbol.

druid.ja: 緑のローブに木の杖の自然の司祭。葉と動物の骨の飾り。
druid.en: A nature priest in green robes with a wooden staff, adorned with leaves and animal bones.

ettercap.ja: クモの特徴を持つ灰紫の人型。大きな牙、爪、糸を吐く。
ettercap.en: A hunched purple-grey humanoid with spider-like features, large fangs, claws and spinnerets.

gargoyle.ja: 石でできた翼のある悪魔像。角と爪、灰色の体が動き出す。
gargoyle.en: A winged stone demon statue come to life, grey body with horns and claws.

gelatinous_cube.ja: 部屋の通路いっぱいの透明なゼリーの立方体。中に骨や剣が浮かぶ。
gelatinous_cube.en: A transparent cube of jelly filling the corridor, bones and a sword suspended inside it.

ghast.ja: グールより大きく腐臭を放つ食屍鬼。灰緑の肌、長い爪。
ghast.en: A larger, fouler ghoul with grey-green skin, long claws and a stench, snarling.

giant_boar.ja: 馬ほどの大きさの黒いイノシシ。巨大な牙。
giant_boar.en: A horse-sized black boar with enormous curved tusks, charging.

giant_constrictor_snake.ja: 部屋を埋める巨大な大蛇。緑褐色の鱗、とぐろで獲物を締める。
giant_constrictor_snake.en: A colossal olive-green constrictor snake coiling around the room, crushing its prey.

giant_elk.ja: 象ほどの大きさの大鹿。巨大な枝角、堂々たる姿。
giant_elk.en: An elephant-sized elk with gigantic antlers, standing majestically.

gibbering_mouther.ja: 無数の目と口がうごめく肉の塊。涎を垂らし、わめく。
gibbering_mouther.en: A shapeless mound of flesh covered in dozens of eyes and gibbering mouths, drooling.

green_dragon_wyrmling.ja: 緑の鱗の小さなドラゴン。頭にひだ飾り、毒の霧を吐く。
green_dragon_wyrmling.en: A small dragon with green scales, a crest of frills on its head, breathing a wisp of poison gas.

grick.ja: ミミズのような灰色の体にくちばしと4本の触手。岩に紛れる。
grick.en: A grey worm-like creature with a snapping beak surrounded by four tentacles, blending into rock.

griffon.ja: 鷲の頭と翼にライオンの体。金茶の毛並みと羽。
griffon.en: A beast with an eagle's head and wings on a lion's body, golden-brown feathers and fur.

hunter_shark.ja: 灰色の大型のサメ。鋭い歯の列と冷たい黒い目、背びれを立てて獲物を追う。
hunter_shark.en: A large grey hunting shark with rows of teeth and cold black eyes.

merrow.ja: 巨大で醜い魚人。緑の鱗と牙、水かきの爪、海藻の飾りをつけ、錆びた銛を構える。
merrow.en: A huge ugly ogre-like sea creature with green scales, fangs and a harpoon.

mimic.ja: 宝箱が口を開けて牙と舌をのぞかせる。箱の縁に歯が並ぶ。
mimic.en: A treasure chest with a gaping toothy mouth and long sticky tongue, lid becoming jaws.

minotaur_skeleton.ja: 牛の頭蓋骨を持つ巨大な骸骨。大斧を構える。
minotaur_skeleton.en: A huge skeleton with a horned bull skull, gripping a great axe.

ochre_jelly.ja: 黄土色の粘液が床を這う。酸で石を溶かす。
ochre_jelly.en: A pool of ochre-yellow slime oozing across the floor, sizzling with acid.

ogre.ja: 醜い顔の巨人。毛皮の腰布、太い腕で巨大な木の棍棒を振り上げ、よだれを垂らす。
ogre.en: A hulking ogre with an ugly face, wearing a fur loincloth and swinging a huge club.

ogre_zombie.ja: 腐ったオーガの死体。皮膚が剥がれ、よろめく。
ogre_zombie.en: A rotting ogre corpse with peeling skin and vacant eyes, lumbering forward.

pegasus.ja: 白い翼を持つ白馬。気高い姿で翼を広げる。
pegasus.en: A white winged horse with feathered wings spread, noble and radiant.

plesiosaurus.ja: 長い首とひれを持つ水棲の恐竜。灰青の皮膚。
plesiosaurus.en: A long-necked marine reptile with four flippers and grey-blue skin.

polar_bear.ja: 白い毛の巨大な熊。氷の上で後ろ足で立ち、黒い鼻と爪を見せて咆哮する。
polar_bear.en: A huge white polar bear roaring on the ice.

priest.ja: 豪華な祭服に聖印の高位司祭。メイスを持ち、威厳のある顔。
priest.en: A senior priest in rich vestments with a holy symbol, holding a mace, dignified.

rhinoceros.ja: 灰色の厚い皮と大きな角のサイ。頭を下げて突進。
rhinoceros.en: A grey rhinoceros with thick hide and a large horn, charging head down.

rug_of_smothering.ja: ひとりでに宙に浮いて襲う刺繍の絨毯。人を包み込もうとする。
rug_of_smothering.en: An ornate patterned rug rising off the floor by itself, curling to smother its victim.

saber_toothed_tiger.ja: 長く湾曲した牙を持つ大型の虎。黄褐色の毛並みに太い前脚、身を低くして忍び寄る。
saber_toothed_tiger.en: A huge tawny tiger with long curved sabre fangs, prowling.

sea_hag.ja: 海藻の髪と鱗だらけの醜い老婆。ぬめる緑の肌。
sea_hag.en: A hideous hag with seaweed hair, slimy green skin and fish-like scales.

silver_dragon_wyrmling.ja: 銀の鱗の小さなドラゴン。優美なひだと輝く目。
silver_dragon_wyrmling.en: A small dragon with gleaming silver scales, graceful frills and bright eyes.

swarm_of_poisonous_snakes.ja: 絡み合う無数の毒蛇の群れ。まだら模様と牙。
swarm_of_poisonous_snakes.en: A writhing tangle of dozens of patterned venomous snakes, fangs bared.

wererat_human.ja: 痩せて鼻の尖った人間。ぼろ服に短剣、ネズミのような目。
wererat_human.en: A thin human with a pointed nose and beady eyes, in ragged clothes with a dagger, rat-like features.

wererat_hybrid.ja: 人とネズミの中間の姿。毛皮、長い尾、牙、ぼろ服に短剣。
wererat_hybrid.en: A human-sized rat-man hybrid with fur, long tail and fangs, in ragged clothes, holding a dagger.

wererat_rat.ja: 人ほどの大きさの巨大なネズミ。赤い目と知性のある顔。
wererat_rat.en: A giant rat the size of a man, red eyes glinting with intelligence.

white_dragon_wyrmling.ja: 白い鱗の小さなドラゴン。一本角と冷気の息。
white_dragon_wyrmling.en: A small dragon with white scales, a single crest horn, breathing frost.

will_o_wisp.ja: 宙に浮く青白い光の玉。ゆらゆらと揺れ、中にかすかな苦悶の顔が浮かぶ。
will_o_wisp.en: A floating ball of pale blue-white light with a faint ghostly face inside.

basilisk.ja: 8本脚の緑灰色のトカゲ。石化の目で睨む。
basilisk.en: An eight-legged grey-green lizard with spiny ridges and petrifying glowing eyes.

bearded_devil.ja: 赤い肌にうねる蛇のような髭の悪魔。ギザギザのグレイブ。
bearded_devil.en: A red-skinned devil with a beard of writhing tendrils, wielding a saw-toothed glaive.

blue_dragon_wyrmling.ja: 青い鱗の小さなドラゴン。鼻先に一本角、稲妻を帯びる。
blue_dragon_wyrmling.en: A small dragon with blue scales, a single horn on its snout, crackling with lightning.

doppelganger.ja: 灰色の肌と白い目、髪のない人型。表情のない顔で変身しかけている。
doppelganger.en: A grey-skinned hairless humanoid with blank white eyes, face mid-shift into another form.

giant_scorpion.ja: 馬ほどの大きさの黒いサソリ。巨大なハサミと毒針。
giant_scorpion.en: A horse-sized black scorpion with huge pincers and a curled stinger.

gold_dragon_wyrmling.ja: 黄金の鱗の小さなドラゴン。顎にひげと優雅な角。
gold_dragon_wyrmling.en: A small dragon with golden scales, whisker-like tendrils on its chin and elegant horns.

green_hag.ja: 緑の肌、長い爪、黒い髪の醜い魔女。ぼろの服。
green_hag.en: A hideous hag with green skin, long black claws, stringy hair and tattered rags.

hell_hound.ja: 黒い毛と赤い目の地獄の犬。口から炎を漏らす。
hell_hound.en: A black hound with glowing red eyes, flames licking from its jaws.

killer_whale.ja: 白黒の模様のシャチ。大きく口を開けて歯を見せ、水しぶきを上げて迫る。
killer_whale.en: A black-and-white orca, mouth open showing teeth, surging forward.

knight.ja: 板金鎧に紋章の盾、長剣を構える騎士。マントをなびかせる。
knight.en: A knight in full plate armour with a heraldic shield and longsword, cloak flowing.

manticore.ja: 人の顔を持つライオンの体、コウモリの翼、棘の尾。
manticore.en: A lion-bodied monster with a human-like face, bat wings and a tail of hurling spikes.

minotaur.ja: 牛の頭を持つ巨大な人型。大斧、黒い毛、鼻輪。
minotaur.en: A huge bull-headed humanoid with dark fur and a nose ring, swinging a great axe.

mummy.ja: 包帯に巻かれた乾いた死体。空洞の目で腕を伸ばす。
mummy.en: A withered corpse wrapped in tattered bandages, hollow eyes glowing, arms outstretched.

nightmare.ja: 炎のたてがみと蹄を持つ黒い馬。目が燃える。
nightmare.en: A black horse with mane, tail and hooves of fire, eyes burning red.

owlbear.ja: フクロウの頭と熊の体。茶色の毛と羽、鋭い爪とくちばし。
owlbear.en: A bear-bodied beast with an owl's head, brown feathers and fur, hooked beak and claws.

phase_spider.ja: 青白い巨大なクモ。半透明に揺らぎ、次元を越える。
phase_spider.en: A giant pale blue-white spider, body shimmering and half-translucent as it phases.

veteran.ja: 傷だらけの歴戦の兵。板金の胸当て、長剣と短剣。
veteran.en: A grizzled scarred soldier in a plate breastplate, longsword and short sword at the ready.

werewolf_human.ja: 毛深く眉の濃い人間。鎖帷子に剣、狼のような黄色い目。
werewolf_human.en: A hairy heavy-browed human in chain mail with a sword, eyes a wolfish yellow.

werewolf_hybrid.ja: 人と狼の中間の姿。灰色の毛、狼の頭、爪と牙、裂けた服。
werewolf_hybrid.en: A towering wolf-man hybrid with grey fur, wolf head, claws and fangs, clothes torn.

werewolf_wolf.ja: 人ほどの大きさの灰色の狼。知性ある黄色い目。
werewolf_wolf.en: A large grey wolf with cunning yellow eyes, snarling.

wight.ja: 鎧をまとった蒼白い死体の戦士。赤く光る目、長剣。
wight.en: A pale undead warrior in old armour, red glowing eyes, wielding a longsword.

winter_wolf.ja: 白い毛の巨大な狼。青く光る目と白い息、牙をむいて雪の中に立つ。
winter_wolf.en: A huge white-furred wolf with ice-blue eyes, breathing frost.

black_pudding.ja: 黒い粘液の塊が床と壁を這う。酸で金属を溶かす。
black_pudding.en: A heaving mass of black slime creeping over floor and wall, dissolving metal with acid.

chuul.ja: 巨大なザリガニのような怪物。緑黒の甲殻、ハサミ、顔の触手。
chuul.en: A giant lobster-like monster with green-black shell, huge pincers and tentacles around its mouth.

couatl.ja: 虹色の羽の翼を持つ美しい蛇。鱗が輝き、神々しい光に包まれて空を舞う。
couatl.en: A feathered serpent with rainbow-coloured wings, glowing with holy light.

elephant.ja: 灰色の巨大な象。長い象牙と鼻を振り上げ、耳を広げて威嚇する。
elephant.en: A huge grey elephant with long tusks and raised trunk.

ettin.ja: 2つの頭を持つ巨人。汚れた毛皮、両手にモーニングスターと斧。
ettin.en: A two-headed giant in filthy furs, one hand with a morningstar, the other a battle axe.

ghost.ja: 半透明の白い亡霊。古い服で宙に浮き、悲しげな顔。
ghost.en: A translucent white ghost in old-fashioned clothes floating in the air, face sorrowful.

lamia.ja: 上半身は美女、下半身はライオンの怪物。金の装飾。
lamia.en: A beautiful woman's torso on a lion's body, adorned with gold jewellery.

red_dragon_wyrmling.ja: 赤い鱗の小さなドラゴン。黒い角と炎の息。
red_dragon_wyrmling.en: A small dragon with red scales, black horns and a puff of flame.

succubus_incubus.ja: コウモリの翼と小さな角を持つ美しい悪魔。黒い衣装、誘惑的な笑み。
succubus_incubus.en: A beautiful fiend with bat wings, small horns and a tail, in dark alluring attire, smiling seductively.

wereboar_boar.ja: 人ほどの大きさの黒いイノシシ。知性ある目。
wereboar_boar.en: A large black boar with curved tusks and intelligent eyes.

wereboar_human.ja: ずんぐりした毛深い人間。革鎧に戦斧、小さな目。
wereboar_human.en: A stocky bristly human in hide armour with a battle axe, small beady eyes.

wereboar_hybrid.ja: 人とイノシシの中間の姿。剛毛、牙、裂けた革鎧。
wereboar_hybrid.en: A boar-man hybrid with bristly hide, tusks and torn hide armour, wielding an axe.

weretiger_human.ja: しなやかな体つきの人間。縞の入れ墨、曲刀と弓。
weretiger_human.en: A lithe human with striped tattoos, carrying a scimitar and longbow, eyes amber.

weretiger_hybrid.ja: 人と虎の中間の姿。橙と黒の縞の毛、爪と牙。
weretiger_hybrid.en: A tiger-man hybrid with orange-and-black striped fur, claws and fangs, muscular.

weretiger_tiger.ja: 人ほどの大きさの橙と黒の縞の虎。知性ある琥珀の目で獲物を見据える。
weretiger_tiger.en: A large tiger with knowing amber eyes, stalking.

air_elemental.ja: 渦巻く風と塵でできた人型の精霊。輪郭が揺らぐ。
air_elemental.en: A humanoid shape of swirling wind and dust, outline constantly shifting.

barbed_devil.ja: 全身に棘の生えた赤黒い悪魔。かぎ爪と尾、燃える目。
barbed_devil.en: A red-black devil covered in barbed spines, with hooked claws, tail and burning eyes.

bulette.ja: サメの頭を持つ装甲の土中獣。灰青の甲殻、巨大な爪。
bulette.en: A shark-headed land beast with grey-blue armoured plates and huge digging claws, bursting from earth.

earth_elemental.ja: 岩と土でできた巨大な人型の精霊。重々しく歩く。
earth_elemental.en: A massive humanoid of rock and earth, slow and heavy, eyes like glowing stones.

fire_elemental.ja: 炎そのものが人型になった精霊。揺らめく輪郭。
fire_elemental.en: A humanoid shape of living flame, body flickering and trailing fire.

flesh_golem.ja: 継ぎ接ぎの死体でできた巨人。縫い目と留め金、虚ろな目。
flesh_golem.en: A hulking golem of stitched-together corpse parts, bolts and scars, vacant eyes.

giant_crocodile.ja: 部屋いっぱいの巨大なワニ。緑黒の鱗と巨大な顎。
giant_crocodile.en: A colossal green-black crocodile with gaping jaws filling the room.

giant_shark.ja: 部屋を埋めるほど巨大な灰色のサメ。黒い目と無数の歯が並ぶ巨大な口。
giant_shark.en: A gigantic grey shark with black eyes and countless teeth.

gladiator.ja: 片腕の鎧と兜、三叉槍と網を持つ闘士。筋肉質。
gladiator.en: A muscular gladiator in a helmet and one-armed armour, holding a trident and net.

gorgon.ja: 全身を鉄の鱗板に覆われた雄牛。鼻から緑の霧を吹き、角を下げて突進する。
gorgon.en: A bull covered in iron plates, snorting green petrifying vapour.

half_red_dragon_veteran.ja: 赤い鱗と角のある人型の戦士。板金鎧と長剣、炎の息。
half_red_dragon_veteran.en: A veteran warrior with red dragon scales and horns, in plate armour with a longsword, breathing fire.

hill_giant.ja: 肥えて醜い巨人。毛皮の腰布と汚れた体、木の幹の棍棒を引きずる。
hill_giant.en: A fat ugly giant in a fur loincloth, carrying a tree-trunk club.

night_hag.ja: 青黒い肌と角、黄色い目の魔女。ぼろの黒衣。
night_hag.en: A hag with blue-black skin, small horns and yellow eyes, in tattered black robes.

otyugh.ja: 3本脚の肉塊。2本の触手と目のついた柄、大きな口。
otyugh.en: A bloated three-legged mass with two tentacles, an eye stalk and a huge toothy mouth, in filth.

roper.ja: 鍾乳石に擬態した岩の怪物。一つ目と大口、6本の触手。
roper.en: A rocky stalagmite-shaped monster with one eye, a wide fanged mouth and six long tendrils.

salamander.ja: 上半身は炎の人型、下半身は蛇。燃える槍を持つ。
salamander.en: A fiery humanoid torso on a serpent body, wielding a burning spear.

shambling_mound.ja: 腐った植物と泥の塊が歩く。蔓と根が絡む。
shambling_mound.en: A walking heap of rotting vegetation and mud, vines and roots dangling.

triceratops.ja: 3本の角と骨の襟飾りを持つ恐竜。灰緑の厚い皮膚で頭を下げて突進する。
triceratops.en: A three-horned dinosaur with a bony frill and grey-green hide, charging.

troll.ja: 緑の皮膚、長い鼻と腕のひょろ長い巨人。爪と牙。
troll.en: A lanky green troll with a long nose, dangling arms, claws and jagged teeth.

unicorn.ja: 額に螺旋の一本角を持つ白馬。たてがみが流れ、神々しい光をまとう。
unicorn.en: A white horse with a single spiralling horn, glowing with holy light.

vampire_spawn.ja: 蒼白い肌と赤い目の吸血鬼。牙と爪、黒い服。
vampire_spawn.en: A pale vampire with red eyes, fangs and claws, in dark clothing, snarling.

water_elemental.ja: 波と泡が渦を巻いて人型になった精霊。輪郭が絶えず流れ動く。
water_elemental.en: A humanoid shape of churning water and foam, surging forward.

werebear_bear.ja: 巨大な茶色の熊。知性ある穏やかな目で後ろ足で立ち上がる。
werebear_bear.en: A huge brown bear with wise, knowing eyes, rearing up.

werebear_human.ja: 大柄で毛深い人間。毛皮の服と大斧、穏やかな目。
werebear_human.en: A large hairy human in furs with a great axe, eyes calm and intelligent.

werebear_hybrid.ja: 人と熊の中間の姿。茶色の毛に覆われた巨体、鋭い爪と大斧を持つ。
werebear_hybrid.en: A bear-man hybrid with brown fur, claws and a great axe, towering and powerful.

wraith.ja: 黒いローブの影のような亡霊。赤い目、腕が闇に溶ける。
wraith.en: A shadowy wraith in a black tattered robe, red eyes, arms dissolving into darkness.

xorn.ja: 3本の腕と3つの目、頭の上に口がある岩の怪物。
xorn.en: A squat rocky creature with three arms, three eyes and a huge mouth on top of its body.

chimera.ja: ライオン、山羊、赤い竜の3つの頭を持つ怪物。竜の翼。
chimera.en: A three-headed beast with lion, goat and red dragon heads, dragon wings and a lion's body.

drider.ja: 上半身はドロウ、下半身は巨大なクモ。黒い肌と白髪。
drider.en: A dark elf torso on a giant black spider body, white hair, wielding a sword.

invisible_stalker.ja: 姿が見えず、風の歪みとして輪郭がかすかに見える人型。
invisible_stalker.en: An invisible humanoid revealed only as a faint distortion of air, like a shimmering outline.

mage.ja: ローブに杖の魔術師。手に魔法の光、本と小物。
mage.en: A robed wizard with a staff, a glowing spell in one hand, spellbook at the hip.

mammoth.ja: 長い茶色の毛と巨大に湾曲した牙のマンモス。鼻を上げて咆哮する。
mammoth.en: A shaggy brown mammoth with huge curved tusks.

medusa.ja: 髪が蛇の女。鱗の肌、石化の目、弓と短剣。
medusa.en: A woman with living snakes for hair, scaled skin and petrifying eyes, holding a bow.

vrock.ja: ハゲワシの頭と翼を持つ大型の悪魔。灰色の羽、爪。
vrock.en: A large vulture-headed demon with grey feathered wings and clawed talons, screeching.

wyvern.ja: 2本脚と翼、毒針の尾を持つ茶色のドラゴン。
wyvern.en: A brown two-legged dragon with large wings and a venomous stinger tail.

young_brass_dragon.ja: 馬より大きな真鍮色のドラゴン。頭の広いひだ。
young_brass_dragon.en: A young brass dragon larger than a horse, with a broad head frill and gleaming scales.

young_white_dragon.ja: 馬より大きな白いドラゴン。冷気の息と一本角。
young_white_dragon.en: A young white dragon larger than a horse, breathing frost, with a single crest horn.

giant_ape.ja: 家ほどの大きさの黒い巨大猿。胸を叩き、牙をむいて吠える。
giant_ape.en: A house-sized black ape beating its chest and roaring.

oni.ja: 青い肌と角の鬼。鎧とグレイブ、牙の笑み。
oni.en: A blue-skinned ogre-like oni with horns and fangs, in armour wielding a glaive.

shield_guardian.ja: 石と鉄の人型構造体。胸に紋章、守るように立つ。
shield_guardian.en: A towering stone-and-iron construct with a sigil on its chest, standing guard.

stone_giant.ja: 灰色の滑らかな肌の巨人。岩を持ち上げる。
stone_giant.en: A giant with smooth grey stone-like skin, lifting a boulder to throw.

young_black_dragon.ja: 馬より大きな黒いドラゴン。酸の息と曲がった角。
young_black_dragon.en: A young black dragon larger than a horse, acid dripping, with forward-curved horns.

young_copper_dragon.ja: 馬より大きな銅色のドラゴン。悪戯っぽい顔。
young_copper_dragon.en: A young copper dragon larger than a horse, with a sly playful expression.

assassin.ja: 黒い衣装に覆面の暗殺者。毒塗りの短剣と吹き矢。
assassin.en: A masked assassin in black, holding a poisoned dagger and a hand crossbow.

chain_devil.ja: 鎖に巻かれた悪魔。棘の鎖が生きているように動く。
chain_devil.en: A devil wrapped in barbed chains that writhe and lash like living things.

cloaker.ja: 黒いマントのように見える怪物。裏に牙と赤い目、尾。
cloaker.en: A creature like a black cloak with a toothy mouth, red eyes and a whip tail underneath.

frost_giant.ja: 青白い肌と白い髭の巨人。毛皮の鎧に角飾りの兜、大斧を構える。
frost_giant.en: A pale blue-skinned giant with a white beard, in furs, wielding a great axe.

hezrou.ja: ヒキガエルのような巨大な悪魔。緑の皮膚、棘と牙。
hezrou.en: A huge toad-like demon with green warty skin, spines and fangs.

hydra.ja: 5つの頭を持つ巨大な蛇竜。緑の鱗、首がうねり、それぞれが牙をむく。
hydra.en: A huge serpent-like dragon with five snapping heads and green scales.

spirit_naga.ja: 人のような顔を持つ巨大な蛇。紫の鱗と牙、魔力を帯びた目。
spirit_naga.en: A giant snake with a human-like face, purple scales and fangs.

tyrannosaurus_rex.ja: 巨大な肉食恐竜。小さな前脚と巨大な顎、灰緑の皮膚で咆哮する。
tyrannosaurus_rex.en: A huge tyrannosaur with tiny arms and massive jaws, roaring.

young_bronze_dragon.ja: 馬より大きな青銅のドラゴン。ひれのような耳と翼。
young_bronze_dragon.en: A young bronze dragon larger than a horse, with fin-like ears and webbed wings.

young_green_dragon.ja: 馬より大きな緑のドラゴン。頭のひだと毒の霧。
young_green_dragon.en: A young green dragon larger than a horse, with head frills and poison breath.

bone_devil.ja: 骨のように痩せた悪魔。サソリの尾、白い骨の体。
bone_devil.en: A gaunt skeletal devil with bone-white body and a scorpion stinger tail.

clay_golem.ja: 粘土でできた巨大な人型。荒い顔と太い腕。
clay_golem.en: A huge humanoid of rough brown clay with a crude face and thick arms.

cloud_giant.ja: 青白い肌の優雅な巨人。豪華な衣装と大剣。
cloud_giant.en: An elegant pale-blue giant in fine clothing, wielding a great sword.

fire_giant.ja: 黒い肌と燃えるような赤髭の巨人。鉄の鎧と巨大な剣、炉のような熱気。
fire_giant.en: A giant with coal-black skin and flame-red beard, in iron armour with a great sword.

glabrezu.ja: 4本腕の巨大な悪魔。2本はハサミ、山羊の角。
glabrezu.en: A huge four-armed demon with two pincer arms, goat horns and a snarling face.

treant.ja: 巨大な歩く老木。樹皮に顔、腕のような太い枝、根で地面を踏みしめる。
treant.en: A gigantic ancient tree with a face in its bark, branches as arms, walking on roots.

young_blue_dragon.ja: 馬より大きな青いドラゴン。鼻先の一本角と稲妻。
young_blue_dragon.en: A young blue dragon larger than a horse, with a snout horn and crackling lightning.

young_silver_dragon.ja: 馬より大きな銀のドラゴン。優美なひだと輝く鱗、気高い目。
young_silver_dragon.en: A young silver dragon larger than a horse, graceful with gleaming scales.

aboleth.ja: 4本の触手と3つの目を持つ巨大な魚のような怪物。緑の粘液。
aboleth.en: A huge eel-like aberration with four tentacles and three red eyes, covered in green slime.

deva.ja: 白い翼の天使。銀の鎧とメイス、神々しい光。
deva.en: A white-winged angel in silver armour with a mace, glowing with holy light.

guardian_naga.ja: 人の顔を持つ巨大な蛇。金緑の鱗と気高い目。
guardian_naga.en: A giant snake with a human-like face, green-gold scales and noble eyes.

stone_golem.ja: 石像のような巨大な人型。彫刻の顔と太い腕、灰色の石の体が動く。
stone_golem.en: A massive statue-like humanoid of carved grey stone, animated.

young_gold_dragon.ja: 馬より大きな黄金のドラゴン。顎のひげと翼。
young_gold_dragon.en: A young gold dragon larger than a horse, with chin tendrils and wide wings.

young_red_dragon.ja: 馬より大きな赤いドラゴン。炎の息と黒い角。
young_red_dragon.en: A young red dragon larger than a horse, breathing fire, with black horns.

behir.ja: 12本の脚を持つ青い蛇竜。長い体に角と稲妻の息。
behir.en: A long serpentine blue monster with twelve legs and crackling lightning breath.

djinni.ja: 青い肌の巨大な風の精。渦巻く下半身、金の装飾。
djinni.en: A huge blue-skinned genie with a lower body of swirling wind and gold jewellery.

efreeti.ja: 赤い肌と炎に包まれた巨大な精。角と黒い髭、大きな曲刀を持つ。
efreeti.en: A huge red-skinned genie wreathed in flame, with horns and a great scimitar.

gynosphinx.ja: 女の顔を持つライオンの体、鷲の翼。穏やかで賢そうな目。
gynosphinx.en: A lion-bodied sphinx with a woman's face and eagle wings, serene and wise.

horned_devil.ja: 大きな角と翼の赤い悪魔。燃える鎖とフォーク。
horned_devil.en: A huge red devil with large horns and bat wings, wielding a burning fork and chain.

remorhaz.ja: 巨大なムカデのような怪物。青白い背中が熱で赤く光る。
remorhaz.en: A huge centipede-like monster with blue-white armour and a back glowing red-hot.

roc.ja: 山のように巨大な鷲。翼が空を覆い、木の幹ほどの爪。
roc.en: A colossal eagle, wings blotting out the sky, talons like tree trunks.

archmage.ja: 豪華なローブと杖の大魔術師。魔法の光を帯びる。
archmage.en: An archmage in ornate robes with a staff, crackling with arcane light.

erinyes.ja: 黒い翼の美しい女悪魔。鎧と長剣、炎の縄。
erinyes.en: A beautiful winged devil in black armour with a longsword and a flaming rope.

adult_brass_dragon.ja: 家ほどの大きさの真鍮のドラゴン。巨大なひだ。
adult_brass_dragon.en: An adult brass dragon as big as a house, with a wide head frill and gleaming scales.

adult_white_dragon.ja: 家ほどの大きさの白いドラゴン。一本角、氷の息と冷たい目。
adult_white_dragon.en: An adult white dragon as big as a house, breathing frost, with a single crest horn.

nalfeshnee.ja: イノシシの頭と小さな翼を持つ肥満した悪魔。牙と病的な光。
nalfeshnee.en: A bloated boar-headed demon with tiny wings and tusks, glowing with sickly light.

rakshasa.ja: 虎の頭と逆向きの手を持つ悪魔。豪華な衣装。
rakshasa.en: A tiger-headed fiend with backwards hands, in opulent silk robes, smiling cruelly.

storm_giant.ja: 紫の肌と白髪の巨人。鎧と大剣、体に稲妻をまとう。
storm_giant.en: A violet-skinned giant with white hair, in armour with a great sword, lightning crackling.

vampire_bat.ja: 赤い目の巨大なコウモリ。人の気配を残す。
vampire_bat.en: A huge bat with red eyes and a faintly human face, vampire in bat form.

vampire_vampire.ja: 蒼白い肌と赤い目の貴族の吸血鬼。黒いマントと牙。
vampire_vampire.en: An aristocratic vampire with pale skin, red eyes and fangs, in a black cloak.

adult_black_dragon.ja: 家ほどの大きさの黒いドラゴン。前に曲がった角、酸の滴る顎。
adult_black_dragon.en: An adult black dragon as big as a house, acid dripping, with forward-curved horns.

adult_copper_dragon.ja: 家ほどの大きさの銅のドラゴン。悪戯っぽい顔。
adult_copper_dragon.en: An adult copper dragon as big as a house, with a sly playful expression.

ice_devil.ja: 昆虫のような青白い悪魔。複眼とハサミ、氷の槍を持つ。
ice_devil.en: An insect-like blue-white devil with compound eyes and an ice spear.

adult_bronze_dragon.ja: 家ほどの大きさの青銅のドラゴン。ひれのような耳。
adult_bronze_dragon.en: An adult bronze dragon as big as a house, with fin-like ears and webbed wings.

adult_green_dragon.ja: 家ほどの大きさの緑のドラゴン。頭のひだと毒の霧の息。
adult_green_dragon.en: An adult green dragon as big as a house, with head frills and poison breath.

mummy_lord.ja: 黄金の装飾の包帯を巻いた王。冠と杖、光る目で威圧する。
mummy_lord.en: A bandaged undead king with gold ornaments, a crown and staff, eyes glowing.

purple_worm.ja: トンネルを掘る巨大な紫の虫。円形の口に牙。
purple_worm.en: A colossal purple worm with a circular maw full of teeth, bursting through rock.

adult_blue_dragon.ja: 家ほどの大きさの青いドラゴン。鼻先の一本角と稲妻の息。
adult_blue_dragon.en: An adult blue dragon as big as a house, with a snout horn and crackling lightning.

adult_silver_dragon.ja: 家ほどの大きさの銀のドラゴン。優美な姿。
adult_silver_dragon.en: An adult silver dragon as big as a house, graceful with gleaming scales.

iron_golem.ja: 鉄でできた巨大な人型。大剣を持ち、目が燃えるように光る。
iron_golem.en: A massive humanoid of dark iron with a great sword and glowing eyes.

marilith.ja: 6本腕の女悪魔。蛇の下半身で、6本の剣を同時に構える。
marilith.en: A six-armed female demon with a serpent lower body, each hand holding a sword.

planetar.ja: 緑の肌と白い翼の天使。大剣と神々しい光。
planetar.en: A green-skinned angel with white wings and a great sword, radiating holy light.

adult_gold_dragon.ja: 家ほどの大きさの黄金のドラゴン。顎のひげ。
adult_gold_dragon.en: An adult gold dragon as big as a house, with chin tendrils and wide wings.

adult_red_dragon.ja: 家ほどの大きさの赤いドラゴン。黒い角と炎の息。
adult_red_dragon.en: An adult red dragon as big as a house, breathing fire, with black horns.

androsphinx.ja: 男の顔を持つライオンの体、鷲の翼。威厳のある顔。
androsphinx.en: A lion-bodied sphinx with a man's face and eagle wings, stern and regal.

dragon_turtle.ja: 亀の甲羅とひれを持つ巨大な竜。蒸気の息を吐く。
dragon_turtle.en: A colossal dragon with a turtle's shell and flippers, breathing scalding steam.

balor.ja: 炎の翼と角の巨大な悪魔。燃える剣と鞭、全身が炎に包まれる。
balor.en: A towering demon with flaming wings and horns, wielding a burning sword and whip.

ancient_brass_dragon.ja: 山のように巨大な真鍮のドラゴン。巨大なひだ。
ancient_brass_dragon.en: An ancient brass dragon as big as a hill, with a vast head frill and worn gleaming scales.

ancient_white_dragon.ja: 山のように巨大な白いドラゴン。一本角、氷の息、古傷のある鱗。
ancient_white_dragon.en: An ancient white dragon as big as a hill, breathing frost, with a single crest horn.

pit_fiend.ja: 赤い鱗と翼の巨大な悪魔の君主。炎のメイス。
pit_fiend.en: A huge red-scaled archdevil with bat wings and horns, wielding a flaming mace.

ancient_black_dragon.ja: 山のように巨大な黒いドラゴン。曲がった角、酸の滴る顎。
ancient_black_dragon.en: An ancient black dragon as big as a hill, acid dripping, with forward-curved horns.

ancient_copper_dragon.ja: 山のように巨大な銅のドラゴン。悪戯っぽい顔。
ancient_copper_dragon.en: An ancient copper dragon as big as a hill, with a sly playful expression.

lich.ja: ローブの骸骨の魔術師。冠と杖、燃える目。
lich.en: A skeletal sorcerer in tattered robes with a crown and staff, eyes burning with cold light.

solar.ja: 6枚の翼の天使。黄金の鎧と大剣、太陽のような光。
solar.en: A six-winged angel in golden armour with a great sword, shining like the sun.

ancient_bronze_dragon.ja: 山のように巨大な青銅のドラゴン。ひれのような耳。
ancient_bronze_dragon.en: An ancient bronze dragon as big as a hill, with fin-like ears and webbed wings.

ancient_green_dragon.ja: 山のように巨大な緑のドラゴン。頭のひだと毒の霧の息。
ancient_green_dragon.en: An ancient green dragon as big as a hill, with head frills and poison breath.

ancient_blue_dragon.ja: 山のように巨大な青いドラゴン。鼻先の一本角と稲妻の息。
ancient_blue_dragon.en: An ancient blue dragon as big as a hill, with a snout horn and crackling lightning.

ancient_silver_dragon.ja: 山のように巨大な銀のドラゴン。優美な姿。
ancient_silver_dragon.en: An ancient silver dragon as big as a hill, graceful with gleaming scales.

kraken.ja: 海を覆う巨大なイカの怪物。無数の触手と巨大な目。
kraken.en: A colossal squid-like sea monster with countless tentacles and enormous eyes.

ancient_gold_dragon.ja: 山のように巨大な黄金のドラゴン。顎のひげ。
ancient_gold_dragon.en: An ancient gold dragon as big as a hill, with chin tendrils and wide wings.

ancient_red_dragon.ja: 山のように巨大な赤いドラゴン。黒い角と炎の息、古傷のある鱗。
ancient_red_dragon.en: An ancient red dragon as big as a hill, breathing fire, with black horns.

tarrasque.ja: 山のように巨大な甲殻の怪物。角と棘、巨大な顎。
tarrasque.en: A mountain-sized armoured monster with horns, spines and a gigantic maw.
